answer:
The father of the father of behaviorism was **Pickens Butler Watson**.

John B. Watson is widely regarded as the "father of behaviorism," and his own father was named Pickens Butler Watson. According to historical records, Pickens Butler Watson was an alcoholic who deserted the family when John B. Watson was 13 years old to live with two Indian women. This early abandonment by his father likely had a significant impact on young John B. Watson's life and may have influenced his later work in psychology regarding child development and behavior modification.
